easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
